result:
All 14 queries ran against the input files and gave plausible answers. Q7 was the only one with no input file, and it ran with nothing piped.

Two of them rest on judgment calls:
- **Q11:** a line with leading spaces before `DB_` would not match the prefix, because I only trim lines when checking for `#` comments. The sample file has no such line.
- **Q14:** an endpoint whose latencies are all null would make `round` fail. That doesn't happen in this data.

Q1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * /email | sort
Q2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") * /items | flat | * (mul /price /qty) | sum | round 2
Q3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (/assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy * count
Q4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | sort
Q5: lines | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) * split " " | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort
Q6: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~/1 * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
Q7: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Date ","cherry"] * lower | distinct | count
Q8: /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) * {:name /name :port (at :net | coalesce {} | at :port | coalesce 80)} | sort ~([(/port | desc) /name]) * (:r / | /name | append ":" | append (r | /port | print))
Q9: groupBy ~/user * count | entries * {:user (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /user]) | take 3
Q10: sort ~([(at :comments | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 * /title
Q11: lines | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | filter ~(trim | startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") * [(split "=" | first | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (split "=" | drop 1 | join "=")] | tag ::map
Q12: filter ~(/total | gt 100) | every ~(at :shipped_at | ne null)
Q13: * (at :tags | coalesce [] | * lower) | flat | distinct | sort
Q14: groupBy ~/endpoint | entries * (:g /1 | {:endpoint (/0 | keyword) :count (g | count) :avgMs (g * (at :latency_ms) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 0)}) | filter ~(/count | gte 2) | sort ~/endpoint
